correctness.rationale: The anchored two-sided Poisson-reset construction establishes a stationary law with finite second moments and unique finite-prefix dynamics. Generator identities give Var(X1)=q=2D/r and stationary Cov(X1,Xj)=q 2^(1-j). The conditional linear semigroup for Xj(t) is e^-rt sum_(k=0)^(j-1)(rt)^k/k! X_(j-k)(0), yielding C_j^+(t)=q2^(1-j)e^-rt sum_(k<j)(2rt)^k/k!, while C_j^-=q2^(1-j)e^-rt. For n=j-1 and u=rt, derivative sign is H_n(u)-1, where H_n is a strictly decreasing positive falling-factorial sum; this gives exactly one interior peak. The uniform expansion H_n(n+c)=1-(2+2c)/n+O(n^-2) yields u=n-1+O(n^-1); Stirling and dominated geometric summation yield Gaussian lag front and O(j^-1/2) peak height. Gamma integration gives the forward/backward integrated ratio 2^j-1. Independently checked exact finite integral identities and numerical unique peaks at j=2,3,5,20,80 (u=0.5,1.366025,3.250531,18.083007,78.023614). Finite checks do not prove the j-to-infinity statement.
